note: Evidence readiness matrix for prototype-stage PH6. Not claiming courtroom admissibility. This is a gap analysis and design target.
standard_reference: Federal Rule of Evidence 702; NIST SP 800-86; ISO/IEC 17025

readiness_categories.description: Who operated the system at time of evidence capture
readiness_categories.current_evidence: hostname in run manifest; no formal operator_id or login record
readiness_categories.gap: No operator identity field in run_status.json or CRAM packets
readiness_categories.action: Add operator_id to run_status.json and session boot record

readiness_categories.description: What hardware was used — serial numbers, camera IDs, firmware versions
readiness_categories.current_evidence: hostname and model in session boot; dual camera roles established
readiness_categories.gap: No serialized hardware manifest in run artifacts; camera serials not captured
readiness_categories.action: Add hardware_manifest.json per run including lsusb, v4l2-ctl output

readiness_categories.description: What test method was used and which version
readiness_categories.current_evidence: test_registry.json provides method_id and command; run_status.json records label
readiness_categories.gap: No method_version field; git HEAD not recorded in run artifacts
readiness_categories.action: Add method_version and git_head to run_status.json

readiness_categories.description: Cryptographic hash of the test script at time of execution
readiness_categories.current_evidence: Script path recorded in run_status.json; hash not captured
readiness_categories.gap: Script could be modified after execution without detection
readiness_categories.action: Hash test script at preflight time; record in run_status.json

readiness_categories.description: Hash of configuration parameters affecting measurement output
readiness_categories.current_evidence: No config file currently separate from script
readiness_categories.action: Define config structure per test method; hash at preflight

readiness_categories.description: Camera focus, exposure, known limitations at time of capture
readiness_categories.current_evidence: brightness and entropy parsed from stdout; Camera B=PRIMARY_MEASUREMENT established
readiness_categories.gap: No structured calibration record; focus mode not captured; no uncertainty statement
readiness_categories.action: Add calibration_state to run artifacts with v4l2-ctl exposure/focus values

readiness_categories.description: Inventory of all files produced with hashes and sizes
readiness_categories.current_evidence: artifacts list in run_status.json; no hashes of output files
readiness_categories.gap: Output files listed but not hashed; manifest not independently signed
readiness_categories.action: Add hash of each artifact to run_status.json at test completion

readiness_categories.description: CRAM event chain from ingest through PASS/DROP to export
readiness_categories.current_evidence: CRAM audit chain in audit.jsonl; CRAM-A .blake2b marker; RSYNC export mandatory
readiness_categories.gap: Export verification receipt not always present in desktop run artifacts
readiness_categories.action: Link CRAM export receipt to test run artifact directory

readiness_categories.description: Evidence that the same input produces the same output (reproducibility)
readiness_categories.current_evidence: REPLAY_PARITY check in CRAM internal harness; documented in test reports
readiness_categories.gap: Replay not run as standard step in every production test run
readiness_categories.action: Include replay verification in method validation records

readiness_categories.description: DROP rate, read failures, frame loss, sensor drift during acquisition
readiness_categories.current_evidence: motion_fraction and frame counts parsed from stdout; DROP verdicts recorded
readiness_categories.gap: No structured error_rate summary field in run artifacts
readiness_categories.action: Add error_rate section to run completion record

readiness_categories.description: Documented constraints on measurement reliability and scope
readiness_categories.current_evidence: Production clearance declaration bounds scope; certification docs note camera limitations
readiness_categories.gap: Known limitations not systematically included in every run artifact
readiness_categories.action: Add known_limitations section to test registry entries and run artifacts

readiness_categories.description: Clear separation between deterministic PSEUDO measurement and AI/SoSo advisory output
readiness_categories.current_evidence: Lane-1/Lane-2 boundary enforced; PASS/DROP only from Lane-1; SoSo labeled PROPOSED; Authority:ZERO in status bar
readiness_categories.gap: Boundary enforced in code but not always explicitly stated in run artifacts
readiness_categories.action: Add authority_statement field to every run artifact JSON

readiness_categories.description: Human-readable and machine-readable summary of the test run
readiness_categories.current_evidence: Markdown and JSON reports generated for certification runs; not for every run type
readiness_categories.gap: Report generation not standardized across all test registry entries
readiness_categories.action: Standardize report format and require both human/JSON for all registered tests

readiness_categories.description: Unbroken record from acquisition through preservation to report
readiness_categories.current_evidence: CRAM audit chain; session timestamps; run_status.json; git history (code history only — NOT evidence authority)
readiness_categories.gap: No unified chain-of-custody document that links all custody events in one artifact
readiness_categories.action: Add custody_chain.json per run linking acquisition → preservation → export → report
readiness_categories.storage_doctrine_note: Git history records code history, not evidence custody. The chain of custody must be established by CRAM audit chain, storage manifests, and export records. Evidence authority must be backend-agnostic and must survive without git in production.

storage_doctrine.statement: Git is the prototype source/version-control layer. It is not the final production evidence-storage authority.
storage_doctrine.rule: Evidence authority must be backend-agnostic. Any storage layer may fail or be unavailable; the CRAM chain and manifests must remain the authoritative record regardless.

summary.note: No gaps are currently blocking prototype operation. All gaps are improvements toward professional evidence readiness for a future finished device.
